sources.title: RULER: What’s the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
sources.version: arXiv:2404.06654v3 [cs.CL], 6 Aug 2024; Published as a conference paper at COLM 2024
sources.authority_reason: Original benchmark paper by Hsieh, Sun, Kriman, Acharya, Rekesh, Jia, Zhang, and Ginsburg; NVIDIA affiliation verified on original first page.
sources.inspection_note: First-page identity; abstract; section 3 introduction and sections 3.1–3.4 including Table 2; section 4 Models & Inference setup and Task configurations. Searches also exposed unrelated official-paper result snippets; no repository author summary was used. Permanent snapshot: docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/phase4-a_9-independent-20261005/sources/ruler-2404.06654v3.pdf. Single, multi-values, multi-queries retrieval; multi-hop tracing; aggregation; QA; answer-presence recall is not a no-extras/order criterion. No published model score is used as a course-model result.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.authority_reason: Original paper by Liu, Lin, Hewitt, Paranjape, Bevilacqua, Petroni, and Liang; original author affiliations verified on first page.
sources.inspection_note: First-page identity and abstract; section 2 and section 2.1 complete setup paragraphs, including annotated-answer selection and ambiguity footnote; section 2.2 decoding paragraph; section 3.1 synthetic key-value setup. Permanent snapshot: docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/phase4-a_9-independent-20261005/sources/lost-middle-2307.03172v3.pdf. Controlled multi-document QA selects one document with a NaturalQuestions annotated answer; distractors exclude annotated answers. Ambiguous reasonable alternatives can exist as stated in footnote 2. It does not test obligatory cross-document combination. Position and length are distinct controlled factors; inference uses greedy decoding.

sources.details: Current necessary A.7 core is personally read, not accepted as its own evidence.
